name: gated-review
description: Evidence-gated code review: business / design / security / full modes, TS-React, NestJS, Python-FastAPI; inline GitLab MR comments only for findings that survived a check

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-gated code review for GitLab MRs
interface.longDescription: A finding becomes an inline MR comment only after a cheap check that could have refuted it (grep, type-checker, test, repo rule, named sibling) failed to. Modes: business, design, security, full.
defaultPrompt: Review this diff for security issues.
Re-review the MR after the author's fixes.
